# Phosphor Icons 2.1.1

Vendored from `@phosphor-icons/web@2.1.1` (https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web).
The MIT license is in `LICENSE`.

The regular, bold and fill styles and WOFF2 fonts are kept locally so that all game
controls work offline. The only stylesheet change removes the unused WOFF, TTF
and SVG fallback URLs; iOS Safari and current browsers support WOFF2.
